name: SEO Gap Observation
subject: {business_name_slug}
body:
Hi,

Was looking at {business_name} in {city}. You rank on page 2 for "{industry} {city}" but {competitor_name} takes the top 3 spot.

Two things they have that you don't:

1. Your title tag says "{actual_title}" which doesn't include the keyword people search
2. No Google Business Profile posts in the last 90 days

Fixed both for a similar {industry} client in Dubai last month. They moved from position 14 to 4 in six weeks.

Worth a look?

Own
notes: Requires scraping prospect website first for real observations. Replace {actual_title} and {competitor_name} with real data.

name: Maps Ranking Gap
subject: {business_name_slug}
body:
Hi,

Searched "{industry} near me" from {city} and {business_name} showed up 7th on Google Maps. Top 3 get 70% of the clicks.

Your reviews are solid ({review_count} at {rating} stars) but your profile is missing category tags and hasn't posted an update recently. Those two things alone usually bump a business up 2-3 spots.

Reply and I'll send a quick screenshot of where you stand vs the top 3.

Own
notes: Best for local businesses that depend on map pack. Use real review count and rating.

name: Specific Website Issue
subject: {business_name_slug}
body:
Hi,

Checked {business_name}'s site. Two things standing out:

1. No SSL certificate (shows "not secure" in Chrome). Google flags this and visitors bounce
2. Page takes {load_time}s to load on mobile. Anything over 3s loses half your visitors

Both are quick fixes. The SSL is free through Let's Encrypt, and the speed issue is usually image compression.

Want me to send a full list of what needs fixing?

Own
notes: Requires checking website for SSL and load time. Replace {load_time} with real measurement.

name: Content Gap Observation
subject: {business_name_slug}
body:
Hi,

Your competitors in {city} are publishing {industry} guides that rank for questions your customers ask. {business_name} has the service pages but no content answering things like "how to choose a {industry_singular} in {city}".

That's free traffic going to competitors who aren't better than you, just better at SEO.

I write {industry} content that ranks. Reply if you want a topic list for your niche.

Own
notes: Good for professional services. Replace {industry_singular} with singular form.

name: No Website Pitch
subject: {business_name_slug}
body:
Hi,

Found {business_name} on Google Maps. {review_count} reviews at {rating} stars but no website linked.

Customers check websites before calling. Without one you're losing leads to competitors with worse reviews but an online presence.

I build fast, SEO-optimized sites for {industry} businesses in the UAE. Takes 2 weeks, includes Google Business Profile setup.

Open to seeing examples?

notes: Only for prospects with no website. Use real review count and rating.
